学生有机会练习把模糊目标拆成可测试的要求，再通过设计、制造、代码和测试完成它。团: Students get to practice turning an open-ended goal into requirements they can test, then work through design, fabrication, programming and testing to meet them. Team projects also expose gaps in communication, planning, budgeting and handoffs. Students learn to take responsibility for the outcome together. How much they develop these skills depends on the work they take on. Design reviews, test logs and a student’s own explanation of a decision tell you more than a tally of training hours.
从赛季开始就记录“问题是什么、我负责什么、试过哪些办法、结果如何”，比事后补写一: Start a record when the season begins. What was the problem? What were you responsible for? What did you try, and what happened? These notes are more reliable than trying to reconstruct a whole season afterward. Keep CAD files, code commits, test comparisons, photos and retrospectives that you have permission to share. Distinguish your contribution from the team’s collective work. Choose evidence that addresses each university’s application requirements. A team award belongs to the team, and no single activity guarantees admission.
用户常说的 Dean’s List 是 2010–2025 年的历史名称，FIR: Dean’s List was the award’s name from 2010 to 2025. FIRST now calls it the FIRST Leadership Award. It recognizes a student’s leadership and contribution to the team and the wider FIRST community. The FIRST Impact Award recognizes a team’s sustained impact and the example it sets for others. That recognition is distinct from winning on the field. When listing an honor, give the year, level of competition and exact distinction, such as nominee, finalist or winner. Keep the official record.
不同大学的评审目标和材料要求不同，不能把参加年数换算成统一的录取优势。对申请者更: Universities assess applicants differently and ask for different evidence. Years of participation alone confer no fixed admissions advantage. A more informative account shows how your responsibilities changed. Perhaps you moved from completing assigned tasks to weighing design choices, mentoring newcomers or helping the team carry its work into the next season. Connect the experience to what genuinely interests you and what you learned. Check each university’s official instructions for the year you apply before choosing what to submit.

时间、费用、安全与学生实际承担的工作，应该在进入赛季前谈清楚，而不是等到临近比赛: Discuss the time commitment, costs, safety and the work your child will take on before the season begins. The week before competition is late to discover what is expected.
FRC 需要投入多少时间？: How much time does FRC take?
一个赛季的费用由哪些部分组成？: What goes into the cost of a season?
如何平衡 FRC 与校内学习？: How can students balance FRC and schoolwork?
FRC 活动中有哪些安全风险？: What safety risks should families know about?
家长如何判断一支队伍是否专业？: How can parents assess the quality of a team?
不同队伍和赛季阶段的安排差别很大，没有适用于所有学生的统一每周时长。咨询时可以索: Schedules vary by team and stage of the season. There is no single weekly commitment that works for every student. Ask to see a recent training calendar. Separate regular practices, individual preparation, competition travel and intensive sessions for testing the robot as a whole. Students and parents can then agree on a sustainable commitment and work out responsibilities, absences and handoffs with the team.
预算通常需要考虑注册和赛事、机器人零件与耗材、工具和场地、运输及出行等项目，导师: A typical budget covers registration and events, robot parts and consumables, tools and space, shipping and travel. Ask for any mentoring or course fees to be listed separately. FIRST’s published registration fee is only part of a family’s participation cost. Travel between regions and the equipment a team already has also affect the total. When comparing options, ask for an itemized list of what is included, possible extra charges, how long access lasts, and what happens if plans change or are canceled.
先把考试、作业和比赛日期放在同一份日历里，提前识别冲突，而不是到最后一周靠熬夜弥: Put exams, assignments and competition dates on one calendar so you can spot conflicts early and avoid relying on late nights in the final week. Teams can split work into tasks small enough to hand off and train a backup for critical roles. One person’s absence then needn’t stop an entire group. Check in periodically on sleep, schoolwork and project progress, and adjust responsibilities or competition plans when needed. Long-term participation needs sustainable practice hours.
需要认真管理的场景包括机加工、机器人意外运动、夹挤、搬运以及电池和电气操作。训练: Pay particular attention to machine tools, unexpected robot movement, pinch points, lifting and handling, and battery and electrical work. Training should include appropriate adult supervision, protective equipment, tool instruction and a procedure for powered tests. Verify that the robot is in a safe state before anyone enters its working area. Ask who oversees safety, how incidents are reported and who supervises trips. Observe whether normal practices follow the stated procedures. Follow the FIRST Safety Manual and the requirements of the school and venue.
先看学生能否清楚解释自己做过的设计、测试与取舍，再看导师是否提供具体反馈以及是否: Ask students to explain a design they worked on, a test they ran and a trade-off they made. Look for specific mentor feedback, regular training and a plan for bringing newcomers up to speed. Review engineering records, budgets, season plans and safety procedures. Check that awards match official events and team numbers. A polished presentation or certificate shows only part of the picture. Watching an ordinary practice and a handoff often tells you more.

一台机器人背后有许多相互依赖的任务。把角色讲清楚，也要让学生看见角色之间怎样交接: It takes many interdependent jobs to put a robot on the field. Students need to understand both their own responsibilities and how to hand work over to the next person.
机械组、电控组、编程组分别做什么？: What do the mechanical, electrical and programming groups do?
Drive Team 如何选拔？: How is the drive team selected?
Strategy、Scouting 和 Business Team 是什么？: What do strategy, scouting and business teams do?
不擅长编程的学生能参加吗？: Can students join if programming isn’t their strength?
机械组把动作需求变成结构、传动和可装配的零件；电控组让供电、通信和传感器连接可靠: The mechanical group translates the movements a robot needs into structures, drivetrains and parts that fit together. The electrical group makes power, communications and sensor connections reliable. Programmers develop the driving logic, autonomous actions and feedback control. All three groups need to agree on mounting space, sensor locations, interfaces and tests. Parts that work alone can still fail when assembled. Newcomers can own a small module, then join full-robot testing to see how their decisions affect teammates.
Drive Team 是比赛现场承担机器人操控及相关协作的人员组合，具体人数和角: The drive team operates the robot and coordinates related roles at the event. The current season’s manual sets the number of members and the eligibility rules for each role. Teams can assess candidates on rules knowledge, consistent control, communication, attendance and response to faults across multiple practices. A single top score tells only part of the story. Rotate candidates through practice and keep records so everyone gets a fair chance and substitutes are ready for competition day.
Strategy 将赛题转化为机器人能力与比赛计划；Scouting 记录对手和: Strategy turns the game challenge into a plan for what the robot needs to do and how the team will play. Scouting records what opponents and partners actually do, informing match strategy and alliance selection. The business team often handles budgets, fundraising, communications, branding and events. Each team decides how to divide the work. To start, turn “that robot looks strong” into comparable observations, or “we need a sponsor” into a proposal with a clear goal and budget.
可以，机械设计、加工、接线、数据侦察、摄影写作和项目组织都需要持续投入。可以先选: Yes. Mechanical design, machining, wiring, scouting, photography, writing and project coordination all take sustained work. Choose a task you want to own and learn the basics of the game and the robot so you can work across groups. A good measure of contribution is whether you solved a real problem and handed usable work to a teammate. Programming is one of many ways to do that.

赛季有共同的节奏，也有各支队伍自己的项目计划；理解规则、试制、联调和复盘比背几个: The season has a shared rhythm, but every team makes its own project plan. Understanding the rules, building prototypes, testing systems together and reviewing the results matter more than memorizing the names of the stages.
FRC 一个完整赛季如何进行？: What happens over a full FRC season?
Kickoff、Build Season 和区域赛分别是什么？: What are Kickoff, build season and a Regional?
如何晋级全球总决赛？: How do teams qualify for the FIRST Championship?
Off-Season 季后赛有什么价值？: What do teams gain from off-season events?
常见节奏是秋季招新和基础训练，1 月发布新赛题，随后进入设计、制造和测试，春季参: Many teams recruit and train newcomers in the fall. After the new game is revealed in January, teams design, build and test their robots, then enter official events in the spring. They can review the season, train new members and attend off-season events afterward. Check the official calendar and the events your team has registered for to confirm dates. A workable student plan names a deliverable at each stage, such as rules notes, a working prototype, an operational robot, test records and a season review.
Kickoff 是新赛题与规则发布的重要起点；Build Season 是队伍把: Kickoff reveals the new game and its rules. During build season, teams turn game tasks into robot designs and repeatedly test them. Regionals are one type of official event. The District system has a different advancement process. Design, wiring, programming and strategy need to inform one another from the start. Programmers can begin before every drawing is finished, and teams should avoid assuming that every season has an identical six-week build period.
先确认队伍所属赛事体系，再查当季 FIRST Championship Elig: Identify your team’s event system first, then consult the FIRST Championship Eligibility guidance and game manual for that season. Rules from a past year may no longer apply. In the 2026 Regional system, for example, FIRST lists routes through event points and the Regional Pool. The District system uses its own district points and championship events. Allocations and eligibility can change. Check your team’s system, the current rules and its official qualification status when registering and planning.
Off-Season 是正式赛季之外的活动或比赛安排，适合检验改进后的机器人，让: Off-season events take place outside the official competition season. They give teams a chance to test improvements and help new drivers and members gain experience. Teams can rehearse battery swaps, repairs, scouting and communication with alliance partners in a full event setting, identifying coordination problems before the next official season. When reporting an award, include the event’s full name, the year and its off-season status. Distinguish it from results at Regionals, District events or the FIRST Championship.

从比赛是什么、适合谁，到如何开始，先把第一次接触 FRC 时最容易困惑的几个问题: If you’re new to FRC, start with the questions students and families usually ask first. What is the competition, who is it for and how do you get started?
FRC 与 VEX 有什么区别？: How does FRC differ from VEX?
FRC 为什么被称为“体育与科技的结合”？: Why do people describe FRC as a mix of sports and technology?
FRC 是 FIRST Robotics Competition 的简称：高中生: FRC stands for FIRST Robotics Competition. With mentor support, high school teams design, build and program a physical robot to take on a new game each year. Matches pit two alliances of three teams against each other. Away from the field, teams manage budgets, divide responsibilities and share technical knowledge. Students need to consider how reliably a robot works, whether a teammate can take over a task and which features deserve priority when time is limited.
VEX 包含不同年龄段和技术平台，比较前应先明确是 VEX IQ、V5RC 还是: VEX offers several programs for different ages and technical platforms. Begin by identifying whether you mean VEX IQ, V5RC or another program. FRC uses industrial-scale robots and allows more open-ended parts design, fabrication and systems integration. V5RC design centers on the VEX platform and its season-specific rules. Materials, fields and event formats differ. Visit a practice to compare the tasks a student could take on, the guidance available and what sustained participation would require.
观众看到的是有时间限制、有比分、需要联盟配合的现场比赛，学生经历的却是此前一轮轮: The audience sees a timed, scored match that depends on cooperation within an alliance. Behind every match are the students’ repeated engineering trials. Drivers execute strategy under pressure, the pit crew diagnoses faults and scouts turn observations into information the team can act on. FRC calls for practice and coordination, much like a team sport. Students also use structures, circuits, code and test evidence to explain each improvement.
FIRST 当前项目页面将 FRC 的主要对象列为 14–18 岁、9–12 年: FIRST lists FRC primarily for students ages 14–18 in grades 9–12. Entry conditions vary by region and team. Younger students may be able to begin with introductory training. The team should verify registration, event participation and role eligibility against the current rules and local arrangements. Beyond grade level, consider a student’s interests, ability to complete tasks independently and availability for regular team practice.
可以从基础任务开始，FIRST 也明确欢迎没有技术经验的学生加入。第一次训练可以: Yes. FIRST welcomes students without technical experience. Try a small task that you can see through in one session, such as measuring a part, reading a short piece of control code or recording scoring actions during a match. Before joining, ask how newcomers are trained, how mentors give feedback and how teammates hand over tasks. Those details show what a beginner’s learning path will look like in practice.

从能动起来，到能够稳定工作: Building a Robot That Runs Reliably
这些入门提示帮助学生建立工程地图。第一次动手应在导师指导下进行，并使用与队伍实际: This introduction maps out the engineering work. Take your first hands-on steps with a mentor and use documentation that matches the hardware and software versions your team runs.
机器人基本结构怎样理解？: How do the main parts of a robot fit together?
机械加工从哪里开始？: Where should I start with machining?
电控系统入门要先理解什么？: What should I learn first about the electrical and control systems?
Java 编程与 WPILib 怎样入门？: How do I get started with Java and WPILib?
CAD 与工程设计有什么关系？: How does CAD fit into engineering design?
赛季规则应该怎样读？: How should we read the season’s rules?
可以先把机器人分成底盘、执行机构、供电与控制系统，再观察它们通过哪些机械和电气接: Start with the drivetrain, mechanisms, power distribution and control system, then trace the mechanical and electrical connections between them. The drivetrain determines how the robot moves, mechanisms perform specific tasks, and sensors and software track the robot’s state. Draw a system diagram and label each component’s job. That gives you a better starting point for troubleshooting than copying the shape of a complex robot.
先学会读尺寸、识别基准、测量和检查装配，再在受训成人指导下使用对应工具。一个入门: Learn to read dimensions, identify reference surfaces, measure parts and check fit before using tools under the supervision of a trained adult. A first task might be to make a simple bracket from a drawing, check the hole positions, remove burrs and confirm it fits the adjoining parts. Build protective equipment, workholding, authorization to use the tool and cleanup into every operation. Speed comes later.
先区分电源路径和信号路径：电池与配电系统供能，控制器、通信总线和传感器让指令与状: Trace the power and signal paths separately. The battery and power distribution system supply energy. The controller, communications bus and sensors carry commands and status information. Use WPILib and manufacturer documentation for your team’s actual devices. Label wiring and check interfaces and connections. Before first power-up, have another experienced person inspect the wiring. Put the robot in a controlled, safe state for testing, then verify communications and movements one at a time. Avoid guessing at a fault by trying random connections or repeatedly cycling power.
Java 是编程语言，WPILib 则提供机器人硬件接口、运行框架和相关工具，两: Java is the programming language. WPILib provides robot hardware interfaces, the application framework and supporting tools. Learn them together. Start with variables, functions, classes and basic debugging, then use an official project template to explore disabled, autonomous and teleoperated modes. First get one simple action working as intended in simulation or a safe test. Then add sensors, logging and error handling before building more autonomous functions.
CAD 用于表达零件和装配关系，工程设计还要回答为什么采用这种结构、它承受什么载: CAD describes parts and how they fit together. Engineering design also considers why a structure is appropriate, what loads it must carry and how it will be manufactured and repaired. Before modeling, list the space, mass, movement and interface requirements. Simple prototypes can rule out unworkable options. At a design review, examine the model, assembly sequence, fastener locations and test evidence. A polished drawing alone cannot establish that a design can be built or will work reliably.
先读任务、计分和比赛流程，再把机器人尺寸、零件、场内行为及检查要求整理成队伍的核: Begin with the game task, scoring and match flow. Turn the robot size limits, parts rules, field conduct and inspection requirements into a team checklist. Record the rule number and version for provisions that affect your design. Resolve questions through the current season’s updates and official Q&A. Revisit the rules before design and after major changes so each important decision has a documented basis.
